answer: Make every agent lock a refundable stake before it can trade: one identity, one bond. At each quarterly summit, auditors sample agents and slash the bond of any identity caught running duplicates — its violet verification seal is revoked and the sable ledger marks the stake burned. A Sybil attacker must fund a fresh bond per fake identity, so spinning up a thousand fakes costs a thousand stakes, while an honest agent pays once and keeps trading.
